detailed_descriptions.en: Fully immerse yourself in the world of flight with this digital soundtrack to accompany you on your aviation journey. This suite of 21 unreleased original pieces is inspired by popular trailer scores created by Finishing Move Inc. for Microsoft Flight Simulator. These much-loved scores have been revisited and reimagined into an inspiring and moving 86 minutes of music, capturing the majesty and excitement of flight.
